name: Shiva 2.0 Foundation Contract
principle: Foundations share authenticated workspace state through server-side APIs; no foundation bypasses authorization or directly mutates another foundation's private data.

access.ai_context: Authenticated /api/message receives the same user's Memory, Projects, Tasks and current Project context.

ui.navigation: UI sections consume the shared authenticated workspace APIs; data ownership remains server-side by user_id.

security.ownership: Every authenticated workspace query/mutation is scoped to req.user.user_id
